preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100000.
The length of the string t must be between 1 and the length of the string s.
The maximum number of pieces x must be between 1 and 30.

postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if it is possible to create the sausage t from s using at most x pieces.
Output 'NO' if it is not possible to create the sausage t from s using at most x pieces.
